scope: Exact-commit U09 review of the three original card requirements, scoped source/receipt correlation, privacy allowlist and final source/test bindings.

The exact P02-U09 card requires turn-scoped message/tool/memory-candidate joins, redacted version/command/error, and separate authorization for raw text with hidden reasoning excluded by default. Code/tests provide masked message facts, pinned closed-vocabulary Native tool facts, reference-only candidate annotations with exact scope/attempt/source event checks, redacted version/command/error summaries and canary allowlist assertions. The documented producer expansion to application/evidence preserves command identity discarded by U06; no production profile or schema migration is added.

Fixed Node v24.14.0 independent U06/U09 selector passed 17/17. Tests execute an owned Node/Git run and actual SQLite commit/readback; mismatched command metadata is rejected. An independent review-only missing-command probe committed a receipt to SQLite and confirmed diagnostics command=unverified with COMMAND_NOT_VERIFIED, while omitting raw path/hash. Receipt verification and command verification remain distinct fields.

Tests bind all scope IDs and attempt, validate facts against committed canonical writer receipts, require zcode.native/v1 plus matching nonconflicting pinned origin before Native classification, and use closed Native/tool enums. Cross-scope/old-attempt/missing-source/partial-read and four sparse/custom-iterator candidate-source negatives are covered. Allowlist canaries cover key, hidden reasoning, unrelated Life, transcript, error, stdout/stderr and path material.

limitations: One independent probe setup attempt exited 1 because it initially placed artifactRoot equal to repositoryRoot; the failed command is preserved as commands/05. The corrected review-only separated artifact-root probe passed as commands/06; this was a reviewer fixture error, not an author-code failure.

An absent command field in a committed receipt does not invalidate the receipt's operation/artifact identity summary, but diagnostics explicitly marks command identity unverified and emits COMMAND_NOT_VERIFIED. Consumers must treat those as separate assertions.

The boundary script reports BOUNDARY_SCAN_NOT_RUN because packages/core is absent. Verification is local owned Node/Git plus synthetic event and real SQLite behavior; Native/Desktop GUI composition, installed host, paid/external model calls, production data, full transcript recovery and physical disk exhaustion were not run.

Diagnostic output retains only closed status/version summaries, salted references and stream digests. Raw argv, paths, transcript text, hidden reasoning and persistent Memory contents are intentionally not exposed; memory candidates are annotations only.
